apple.filters: Students > Internships team, keyword MBA, newest first; results are read from the JSON the page embeds
apple.note: Apple posts one US 'MBA Internships' talent-pool role; postDateInGMT gives the posted date.

amazon.filters: US only; keyword MBA within Student Programs (where every 2027 MBA role sits), plus 'MBA intern' across all categories
amazon.note: Full-time MBA roles (MLDP Full-Time, ALA PM Full Time, Pathways Full-time) come back in the same search and are filtered out.

intuit.filters: keyword MBA (TalentBrew search returns the list as HTML in JSON); each new job page's JSON-LD gives datePosted

adobe.filters: keyword MBA, narrowed to the 'Intern (Fixed Term)' worker type when Workday offers that facet; job detail gives startDate, endDate and country

microsoft.filters: US, keyword MBA, newest first (10 per page); MBA internships aren't all tagged 'Intern' seniority, so that filter isn't used
microsoft.note: Rate-limits quickly (HTTP 429 on the second request within a second); the script waits 3 s between calls here.

salesforce.filters: keyword MBA, narrowed to the 'Intern (Fixed Term)' worker type; job detail gives startDate, endDate (stated close date) and country

google.filters: Interns & apprentices, keyword MBA, all countries (so EMEA-only postings can be reported); results are read from the data the page embeds
google.note: No public API: the parser reads the page's embedded AF_initDataCallback array, so a Google layout change shows up as a failure, not a silent miss.

nvidia.filters: keyword MBA, narrowed to the 'Intern (Fixed Term)' worker type when any intern matches
nvidia.note: NVIDIA MBA roles close within days, so a daily check is the minimum useful frequency.

meta.reason: metacareers.com renders results client-side from an undocumented GraphQL endpoint with rotating query ids and session tokens; no stable public API.

airbnb.filters: the whole public board (about 150 jobs), filtered client-side

uber.reason: jobs.uber.com answers scripts with a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403), and the old uber.com loadSearchJobsResults API is retired (404).

openai.filters: the whole public board (about 830 jobs, 13 MB with descriptions), filtered client-side
openai.note: hiring.json says OpenAI has no MBA program, so a match is reported for a person, not written.

cisco.filters: keyword MBA, narrowed to the 'Intern (Fixed Term) (Seasonal) (Trainee)' worker type when any intern matches

dell.filters: keyword MBA (matches descriptions too), newest first; requisition detail gives the stated end date

ibm.filters: US internships, keyword MBA or 'Master of Business Administration' (some IBM MBA postings only spell it out)
ibm.note: The index gives no posted dates, and careers.ibm.com job pages sit behind a bot check, so new IBM postings are added without a date.

paypal.filters: keyword MBA, narrowed to an intern worker type when Workday offers one
paypal.note: PayPal MBA postings have stayed up only 4-8 days, so a daily check matters most here.

servicenow.filters: US, keyword MBA and keyword intern; typeOfEmployment 'intern' is read per posting

tiktok.filters: keyword MBA, all locations; the job subject ('MBA Intern - 2027 Start') and recruit type ('Intern') are read per posting
tiktok.note: The API gives no posted dates. 'Project Intern ... 2026 Start (MBA)' roles are off-cycle and filtered out by year.

visa.filters: keyword MBA on both Visa Workday sites (corporate.visa.com/jobs redirects to the first), narrowed to the 'Intern' job family when any intern matches
visa.note: Visa's old SmartRecruiters board is empty (0 postings) since the move to Workday.

waymo.filters: the whole public board (about 360 jobs), filtered client-side; first_published gives the posted date

workday.filters: keyword MBA on the main and Early Career Workday sites (past MBA roles appeared on both)
